What we do

Every layer of protection, one contractor.

From the camera on the gate to the wiring behind the wall, we design, install and stand over the whole system ourselves.

CCTV & Surveillance

The latest IP camera technology, designed around your site's blind spots, with footage you can check from anywhere.

  • HD and IP camera systems
  • Remote viewing on phone or desktop
  • Storage and retention set up correctly

Access Control & Intercoms

Design and installation of all types of access control, from a single door entry to fully managed multi-site systems.

  • Fobs, keypads and card readers
  • Video and audio intercoms
  • Staff access managed centrally

Intruder Alarms

Quality intruder alarm systems supplied, installed and maintained, with monitored options for out-of-hours cover.

  • Wired and wireless systems
  • Monitored alarm options
  • Servicing to NSAI standards

Gates, Barriers & Bollards

Automatic gates, rising barriers, bollards and car parking systems for controlled, secure entrances.

  • Swing and sliding gate automation
  • Rising barriers and bollards
  • Car park management systems

Automatic Doors & Turnstiles

Sliding, swing and all automatic doors, plus quality turnstile systems, supplied, installed and maintained.

  • Sliding and swing door systems
  • Turnstiles and pedestrian gates
  • Planned preventative maintenance

Commercial Electrical

Electrical installation and maintenance for businesses, organisations and individuals, to ETCI standards.

  • Fit-outs and rewires
  • Lighting and power
  • Testing and maintenance

EV Charging

Charge point specialists for commercial and residential applications, from a single unit to a full car park.

  • Commercial charge points
  • Home charger installation
  • Load management and wiring

When an alarm goes off at 3am, we answer.

Maintenance contract customers get their own helpdesk number and round-the-clock emergency cover. Regular servicing keeps systems compliant, reduces downtime and extends the life of every component.

Servicing is carried out to NSAI and ETCI standards. Most insurers now require regular servicing of safety and security equipment.

24/7 support line (01) 200 3266
  • Dedicated helpdesk number unique to your site, answered day and night.
  • Priority call-outs with discounted rates on parts and labour.
  • Compliance servicing that satisfies insurers and keeps certification current.

32 counties. One team.

  • Head officeTallaght, Dublin 24

The EES fleet, stocked and on the road. Most call-outs are handled from the van, first visit.

A 100% Irish-owned company, trusted with the security of Irish businesses for 25 years.

EES was established in Dublin in 2000. Since then we have built a reputation on state-of-the-art equipment, quality workmanship and systems delivered on time and within budget. Increasingly, our work means interconnecting CCTV, access control, alarms and intercoms into one integrated system that is easy to manage.

Survey

We walk your site, find the weak points and spec a system around how the premises actually operates. No generic packages.

Install

Our own engineers carry out the work, electrical and security together, so there is one contractor and one standard of finish.

Maintain

Servicing contracts, 24/7 emergency cover and a helpdesk number of your own. We stay accountable long after handover.

Clients who stay.

Facilities managers, healthcare providers and property companies across Ireland rely on EES year after year.
